content:
This month, Apple will unveil its first foldable iPhone — reportedly to be named iPhone Ultra. The device is said to feature a 5.5-inch outer display and a 7.6-inch inner display. Samsung already launched the new Galaxy Z Fold 8 back in July, which also uses the exact same screen sizes.

Whether Samsung intentionally released this phone ahead of the iPhone Ultra is another matter — but regardless, the Galaxy Z Fold 8 has given us a rough idea of what the actual user experience of the iPhone Ultra might be like.

Reviewers who got early hands-on time with the Galaxy Z Fold 8 have recently been posting various comparison photos on Twitter. Since the iPhone Ultra and Galaxy Z Fold 8 are similar in size, these comparisons give us an early preview of what the iPhone Ultra will look and feel like in real-world scenarios.

Ray Wong published several comparison photos of the Galaxy Z Fold 8 alongside the previous-generation iPad mini, highlighting how this phone truly fits an iPad mini-sized screen in your pocket — and with even narrower bezels.

Meanwhile, enthusiast Shishir shared comparison shots of the iPhone 13 mini with the Galaxy Z Fold 8. The iPhone 13 mini is slightly taller than this foldable, but both are equally compact. For users who love the iPhone mini lineup, the iPhone Ultra may recapture that feeling.

Personally, after getting hands-on time with the Galaxy Z Fold 8 last week, I'm actually even more excited about the iPhone Ultra. The two are nearly identical in size (though the iPhone Ultra is reportedly adopting rounded corners) — so before its official debut in September, this is the best preview we have of what Apple has up its sleeve.

Of course, you can also refer to dummy unit photos for further comparison.
